confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors rest on one official Tokyo Special Wards eating-out beer index (¥667, January 2026, serving size not stated) plus cappuccino listings from other Japanese cities, adjusted for Nara. No Nara-specific restaurant or bar data was found. Accommodation is weakly sourced: Nara hostel dorm averages ranged from about 7 to 28 USD across sites, and 3-star averages were reported only in Singapore dollars and ringgit, as undated snapshots, so they were converted by judgement. Yen figures were converted at an assumed rate near 150 yen per US dollar, since no current yen rate was retrieved. Cocktail and wine anchors are derived from the beer anchor using typical Japanese bar and restaurant markups because direct data was weak. FX: the 2026-10-16 value of 0.6947 came from search summaries attributing it to the RBA statistics page; the RBA page itself was not read directly, and a 15 October reading of 0.6955 also appeared, so verify against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city used. Nara is a mid-sized Kansai tourist city, so national Japanese price levels were applied, anchored to the Tokyo Special Wards beer index and Japanese cappuccino listings, with a modest discount to Tokyo-level pricing. Accommodation anchors reflect Nara aggregator averages for hostels and hotels, reconciled across sources and currencies.
